title: Products
description: Canonical product registry for the PWB product relationship layer (nutritional supplements). PRD codes are stable internal identifiers used by product-bioactives.json, product-nutrients.json and product-mechanisms.json, mirroring foods.json for the supplement side of recommendations.

claims.description: Provable, factsheet-derived health claims for this product. Not free marketing copy — each entry should trace back to an approved claim or a manufacturer factsheet statement.

servingSize.description: The amount taken in a single administration, e.g. "2 capsules" or "1 sachet (9.83 g)". Paired with servingsPerDay to describe full dosing.

servingsPerContainer.description: How many single-administration servings (per servingSize) the container holds. Replaces the old 'servings' field.

servingsPerDay.description: How many single-administration servings are taken per day. servingsPerContainer / servingsPerDay gives the computed 'lasts X days' figure.

image.description: Path or filename of the product packshot image, supplied by Simon.

cost.description: One-off retail price for one container, in the site's base currency (GBP). The subscribe & save price and the per-day price are both derived from this at report-build time, not stored separately.

shopUrl.description: Link to this product's page in the Synergy shop, used by the report's 'more information' link. Currently a bare product URL; once the consultant/team-member feature is built, the consultant's id will be appended as a query parameter so the shop and any follow-up email are personalised to whoever sent the report.

factsheetUrl.description: Link to a downloadable PDF factsheet for this product, offered from the 'More about' expander on the Recommended Products section of the report.

allergens.description: Allergens this product actually contains, using the same 14-slug UK FSA vocabulary as foods.json and SAF006.

dietaryExclusions.description: Dietary preferences (PF020 vocabulary) this product VIOLATES, matching the foods.json convention — e.g. a product containing bovine gelatin lists "vegetarian" and "vegan" here, not the preferences it complies with.

formulatedFor.description: Hand-reviewed (factsheet-grounded, Simon-approved) tag of which body systems and outcomes this product is genuinely formulated for. Distinct from the mechanism-matching that drives clinicalScore: this is a targeted 'this is what it's actually for' signal that ProductResolver uses for a modest ranking boost (PRIMARY_FLAGSHIP_BONUS / SECONDARY_FLAGSHIP_BONUS / OUTCOME_MATCH_BONUS) when it aligns with the person's own top body-system priority or selected wellness goals — never a hard override. A product with no clean single-system or outcome fit (broad-spectrum foundational products) can omit this field entirely.

primaryBodySystems.description: Must match ids in body-systems-mechanisms.json. The system(s) this product is a flagship formulation for.

secondaryBodySystems.description: Must match ids in body-systems-mechanisms.json. Genuinely relevant but not the flagship purpose.

outcomes.description: Must match ids in outcomes.json. Wellness goals/outcomes this product is confirmed to meaningfully support.

exactFor.description: Must match ids in outcomes.json, and should normally be a subset of 'outcomes'. The narrow, explicitly Simon-approved 'this is exactly what it's for' designation - deliberately NOT derived from primaryBodySystems overlap (that was tried and came out too broad, e.g. SleepWell forcing itself into a Better Fitness result on a shared Nervous-system link). ProductResolver uses this list, and only this list, for the forced-inclusion floor (guaranteed top-3 placement when a person selects a matching goal) - a product with no exactFor entry can never be forced in, no matter how its body systems or mechanisms overlap.
